description: Header file defining structures, enums, and function prototypes for managing background DFS (Dynamic Frequency Selection) operations in a wireless device, including configuration, status, and statistics.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_setAvailable
methods.description: Update the background DFS feature availability for a given radio.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_notifyClearStarted
methods.description: Notify that a background DFS clear has started with specified channel, bandwidth, and type.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_notifyClearEnded
methods.description: Notify that a background DFS clear has ended with a specified result.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_startExt
methods.description: Start an external background DFS process with given arguments.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_clearTimeEllapsed
methods.description: Return the elapsed time of the current clear operation.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_isRunning
methods.description: Check if a background DFS clear is currently in progress on the given radio.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_update
methods.description: Synchronize the datamodel object with local values for a given radio.
